label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_01
text: Guess that’s that...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_system_01
text: About a year and a half ago...

label: ajito_aku_040_fairyboss_01
text: What’s up, Giacomo? Did something happen?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_02
text: The big boss just wanted my take on some stuff...\nSo we had a chat and settled on a few plans.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_honooboss_01
text: “A few plans”...? Like, for what?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_03
text: Operation Star, first of all. And also...a new code\nof conduct for the team.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_04
text:
You know how tons of new members have joined
up recently?\c
Well, we figure we gotta make some team rules—
like a code—so we’ll all be on the same page.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_kakutouboss_01
text: Nice! You’ll come up with a great code for us,\nwon’t you, Giacomo?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_05
text: Hah, no thanks. Waaay too much pressure.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_06
text: I mean, yeah, I used to be president of the\nstudent council. But you know everyone ended\r\nup hating me after that, right?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_honooboss_02
text:
’Course we know. You forced a ton of stuffy
rules on everyone, and they wouldn’t take it.\c
We got some other nerd to replace you after,
like, five minutes.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_aku_040_dokuboss_01
text:
I cannot help but concur...\c
“Male students’ hair must stray no further than
1.8 inches below the nape” and so forth...\c
Your rules were vexation made manifest![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_07
text: My point exactly! So you’ll all agree that I\nshouldn’t be let anywhere near this new code.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_fairyboss_02
text: But you always know what’s best for the team,\nGiacomo! You look out for us![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: ajito_aku_040_kakutouboss_02
text: You’ve earned our trust many times over. Without\nyou, Team Star just wouldn’t work.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_aku_040_honooboss_03
text:
That stuck-up student council prez isn’t who you
are anymore, man.\c
A code written by the Giacomo I’m lookin’ at
now... I’d follow that any day.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_aku_040_dokuboss_02
text: As would I![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_08
text: OK, OK, thanks for the ego boost, everyone.\nI’ll do it... I’ll write up the darn code.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_09
text: I did the best I could...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_10
text: I wrote that code myself, and there’s no goin’\nback on it now. My days as a boss are over.\r\nSo here—take my Star Badge, would ya?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_waza_01
text: I’ll give you this choice TM, too. You earned it\nfair ’n’ square.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_11
text: Haaah. So this is how the party ends...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_12
text: But let’s talk about th[VAR 0x1101(00FD,0302)]atose Pokémon of yours.\n[VAR 0x1101(00FD,0704)]It’sThey’re crazy strong, huh.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_13
text: You learn those Trainer chops at the academy?\nLike, what moves you should use ’n’ stuff?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_select_01
text: Sure did!

label: ajito_aku_040_select_02
text: Nope

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_14
text: Huh. OK... You like it at the academy?\nHavin’ fun?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_select_03
text: Yeah, I’m enjoying it!

label: ajito_aku_040_select_04
text: It’s not the best...

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_15
text: No kiddin’...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_01
text: Sorry to interrupt, but are you Giacomo?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_16
text: Whoa-ho! Wasn’t expecting a giant pompadour\nto make a guest appearance today.\c\nYou get a Quaxwell to style that up for ya?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_02
text: I’m just after a quick word. Would you mind?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_17
text: Sure. I can tell it’s gonna be somethin’ annoying,\nbut I guess I’m newly freed up for time.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_08
text: Thanks. I’ll get straight to it.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_09
text: It seems all of you in Team Star are headed for\nexpulsion if you keep up your current activities.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_10
text: So why won’t you break up the team and start\nattending class at the academy again?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_23
text: That’s what you wanna know?\c\nAs it happens, we’re actually waitin’ on a pal...\nthough we don’t know if they’ll be comin’ back.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_11
text: A pal...? A close friend of yours, are they?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_24

label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_12

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_25
text:
They’re only the strongest boss in all of
Team Star!\c
Like how there’s a Top Champion who’s the
absolute number-one Trainer, y’know?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_26
text: They’re the one who invited us other bosses to\nform the team. We call ’em the “big boss.”[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_13
text: And where is this big boss of yours now?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_27
text: Wouldn’t we like to know. We haven’t heard from\n’em in, I dunno...must be a year and a half now.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_14

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_28
text: We thought that if we kept Team Star going, then\nthey’d get back in touch one day.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_29
text: But the teachers keep pressin’ us to call it quits,\nand then we get party crashers like you two...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_30
text: Maybe the big boss did ditch us... They were\ntalkin’ about breakin’ up the team before and all.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_16
text: So, Team Star and this big boss of yours...\nThey’re really that important to you?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_31
text:
Heh. Is the sky blue?\c
Let me put it in words you eggheads at the
academy might understand...\c
They’re my greatest treasure.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
